result.summary: The page is generally well structured, but horizontal content is visibly clipped at the right edge and the bottom navigation overlaps the scrolling restaurant content.

issues.description: The horizontal category row is cut off on the right: an unlabeled partial pill is visible after “Healthy,” rather than a complete item or a clear scroll affordance.
issues.suggestion: Constrain the carousel cleanly to the viewport, add appropriate end padding/fade or a visible horizontal-scroll cue, and ensure partially visible chips do not look truncated.

issues.description: The “Fastest near you” restaurant carousel is clipped at the right edge, leaving the third card’s image and title (“Trattoria Piccol…”) visibly truncated.
issues.suggestion: Use deliberate carousel peeking with enough space for the partial card, or adjust card widths/padding so the viewport does not awkwardly crop restaurant titles and card content.

issues.description: The fixed bottom navigation overlays the second “Popular right now” restaurant card, obscuring a substantial portion of its content.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom safe-area/content padding equal to the navigation height so the final scrollable cards can be fully viewed above the fixed navigation.
